prompt: A map has a scale of 1 : 25 000. Two villages are 8 cm apart on the map. Work out the real distance between them, in kilometres.
explanation: Each 1 cm on the map is 25 000 cm in real life, so 8 cm is 8 × 25 000 = 200 000 cm. 1 km = 100 000 cm, so that is 200 000 ÷ 100 000 = 2 km.
hint: Multiply the map distance by the scale number to get centimetres, then change centimetres to kilometres.
source_ref: Pearson Edexcel GCSE Mathematics (1MA1) content reference R2
